target.title: fix(auth): bind OAuth and sessions to immutable identity
target.body:
## Summary

Harden the two GitHub authentication identity boundaries:

- bind portal OAuth callbacks to the browser that initiated login
- bind signed sessions and durable ownership to GitHub's immutable numeric account ID

## Changes

- issue a short-lived `__Host-crabbox_oauth` cookie and retain only its SHA-256 hash
- validate the browser binding before exchanging the authorization code
- clear the binding after terminal portal outcomes
- use `github:<numeric-id>` as the authenticated owner identity
- re-fetch `/user` during membership revalidation and require its account ID to match the session owner
- reject legacy email-owned sessions instead of automatically transferring access to the current holder of that email
- preserve verified email checks and the existing CLI OAuth confirmation flow

## Compatibility

Existing GitHub sessions or durable records owned by an email fail closed for non-admin access and require explicit migration or recreation. No email-to-account ownership transfer is performed automatically.

Administrators should use immutable `github:<numeric-id>` values in `CRABBOX_GITHUB_ADMIN_OWNERS`; the existing login allowlist remains supported for compatibility.

## Validation

Added focused regression coverage for:

- missing or incorrect portal browser binding
- successful one-time callback and cookie cleanup
- callback replay
- immutable account ID revalidation
- account ID mismatch
- rejection of legacy email-owned sessions
- organization, team, and revocation checks

Full repository CI is pending on this draft PR.

target.title: fix(feishu): DMs send a spurious no-visible-reply fallback after an intentional silent NO_REPLY
target.body:
Related: #109912

<details>
<summary>Additional instructions</summary>

**MUST:** Keep **Allow edits from maintainers** enabled for this PR so maintainers
can help update the branch when needed.

</details>

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Feishu users in a direct message (DM) would receive a spurious "⚠️ This reply completed without visible content..." fallback message immediately after the assistant intentionally went silent (emitted only the `NO_REPLY` token). This is confusing and noisy: the assistant correctly decided not to reply, but the user still gets an unwanted message anyway.

## Why This Change Was Made

Feishu's default `blockReplyBreak: "message_end"` setting routes the final assistant text through `sendBlockReply` (dispatch `kind: "block"`), not `sendFinalReply` (`kind: "final"`). When the model's only visible output is `NO_REPLY`, the shared `normalizeReplyPayload` helper correctly detects this as an intentional silent skip and calls `onSkip(payload, { kind: "block", reason: "silent" })`. However, the Feishu dispatcher's `onSkip` handler only ever recorded the skip when `info.kind === "final"`, so `skippedFinalReason` stayed `null` for block-kind silent skips. `ensureNoVisibleReplyFallback` then treated the turn as an ordinary empty response and sent the "no visible content" fallback — a path that is reachable specifically in DMs, where silent finals are disallowed by policy (`src/shared/silent-reply-policy.ts`), and is on for `main`.

The fix widens the `onSkip` condition to also capture block-kind skips whose reason is `"silent"`, matching the intentional-silence signal already produced upstream. It intentionally stays narrow: non-silent block skips (e.g. `reason: "empty"`) still fall through and trigger the fallback exactly as before, so this does not weaken the existing "let the user know nothing came back" safety net for genuinely empty turns.

## User Impact

Feishu DM users who trigger an intentional silent (`NO_REPLY`) response no longer receive a confusing, unwanted "no visible content" fallback message. Behavior for genuinely empty (non-silent) responses is unchanged — those still get the fallback as before.

## Evidence

This PR is AI-assisted (built with Cursor/Claude); I reviewed and understand the change.

### Real dispatch-pipeline proof (added in response to ClawSweeper review)

The strongest evidence in this PR is two tests that drive the **actual production call path** — `createReplyDispatcherWithTyping` → shared `normalizeReplyPayload` → Feishu's real `onSkip` closure — instead of invoking the captured `onSkip` callback directly like the original two tests do. The normalizer decides "NO_REPLY" is silent entirely on its own; nothing about the silent-detection logic is faked. Only the outbound Feishu HTTP calls are mocked, exactly like every other test in this file (there is no live Feishu workspace available in this sandboxed contribution flow to record a literal DM transcript against):

```ts
it("suppresses the fallback for a real NO_REPLY block reply through the full dispatch pipeline", async () => {
  const { result, options } = createDispatcherHarness({ runtime, sessionKey: "main" });
  const { dispatcher } = createReplyDispatcherWithTyping(options);

  dispatcher.sendBlockReply({ text: "NO_REPLY" });
  await expect(result.ensureNoVisibleReplyFallback("empty-complete")).resolves.toBe(false);

  expect(sendMessageFeishuMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
});

it("still delivers the fallback for a real genuinely-empty block reply through the full dispatch pipeline", async () => {
  // ...same setup...
  dispatcher.sendBlockReply({ text: "" });
  await expect(result.ensureNoVisibleReplyFallback("empty-complete")).resolves.toBe(true);

  expect(sendMessageFeishuMock).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
});
```

Before/after proof for these two tests (reverted the one-line fix, ran them, restored the fix):

Before fix — the positive case fails exactly as the bug predicts, through the real pipeline:

```text
❯ |extension-feishu| ../../extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts (96 tests | 1 failed | 94 skipped)
    × suppresses the fallback for a real NO_REPLY block reply through the full dispatch pipeline

AssertionError: expected true to be false // Object.is equality
- Expected: false
+ Received: true
 ❯ extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts:2136:72
    dispatcher.sendBlockReply({ text: "NO_REPLY" });
    await expect(result.ensureNoVisibleReplyFallback("empty-complete"))...

Test Files  1 failed (1)
     Tests  1 failed | 1 passed | 94 skipped (96)
```

(The companion "genuinely-empty" test passes even before the fix, confirming it isn't just duplicating the positive case.)

After fix, full file run:

```text
 RUN  v4.1.10 /Users/.../openclaw

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  96 passed (96)
```

### Original unit-level proof (invoking the captured onSkip directly)

Before fix (`info.kind === "final"` only), targeted run:

```text
❯ |extension-feishu| ../../extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts (94 tests | 1 failed | 92 skipped)
    × does not send no-visible-reply fallback after an intentional silent block reply

AssertionError: expected true to be false // Object.is equality
- Expected: false
+ Received: true
 ❯ extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts:2098:72
    options.onSkip?.({ text: "NO_REPLY" }, { kind: "block", reason: "silent" });
    await expect(result.ensureNoVisibleReplyFallback("empty-complete")).resolves...

Test Files  1 failed (1)
     Tests  1 failed | 1 passed | 92 skipped (94)
```

### Targeted extension lane

`pnpm test:extension feishu` (85 test files): all Feishu reply-dispatcher tests pass. One unrelated pre-existing failure in `extensions/feishu/src/delivery-trace.test.ts` ("dispatcher options were not captured") reproduces identically on unmodified `upstream/main` before this change — filed separately as #110744 (stale test-capture seam left behind by #110095, which updated the equivalent `msteams`/`slack` tests but missed Feishu's). It is unrelated to `reply-dispatcher.ts`/`reply-dispatcher.test.ts` and is why the `checks-node-changed-*` / `openclaw/ci-gate` check on this PR is currently red — I did not fix it here to keep this PR focused, per `CONTRIBUTING.md`'s guidance on already-broken, unrelated CI:

```text
 Test Files  1 failed | 84 passed (85)
      Tests  5 failed | 1237 passed (1242)
```

### Lint/format

Both touched files:

```text
$ oxfmt --check extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.ts extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.

$ node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.ts extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts
(exit 0, no findings)
```

**Diff scope**: one line changed in `extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.ts` (widen the `onSkip` guard), plus four regression tests (two direct-callback, two full-pipeline) in `extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts`. No other files touched.
